MLA vLLM support.title: Supported Models and Attention Backends — vLLM
MLA vLLM support.snippet: vLLM implements a dedicated MLA (Multi-head Latent Attention) backend for DeepSeek-V2 and DeepSeek-V3 style models. The MLA path stores the compressed latent KV representation instead of per-head key and value tensors, which reduces paged KV cache footprint relative to the standard MHA backend.
MLA vLLM support.content: vLLM implements a dedicated MLA (Multi-head Latent Attention) backend for DeepSeek-V2 and DeepSeek-V3 style models. The MLA path stores the compressed latent KV representation instead of per-head key and value tensors, which reduces paged KV cache footprint relative to the standard MHA backend. Enabling the backend requires a model config that declares MLA-specific projection dimensions; models without those fields fall back to the generic attention backend.

PIM CXL production deployment.content: Analysts note that PIM and PNM devices are sampled to selected customers and that no vendor has disclosed volume production for LLM inference servers. Reporting on PIM and PNM silicon notes that evaluation is limited to vendor sampling programmes, and that independent groups have not published reproductions of vendor-reported inference numbers on their own hardware.

Multi-head Latent Attention framework ve.title: Supported Models and Attention Backends — vLLM
Multi-head Latent Attention framework ve.snippet: vLLM implements a dedicated MLA (Multi-head Latent Attention) backend for DeepSeek-V2 and DeepSeek-V3 style models. The MLA path stores the compressed latent KV representation instead of per-head key and value tensors, which reduces paged KV cache footprint relative to the standard MHA backend.
Multi-head Latent Attention framework ve.content: vLLM implements a dedicated MLA (Multi-head Latent Attention) backend for DeepSeek-V2 and DeepSeek-V3 style models. The MLA path stores the compressed latent KV representation instead of per-head key and value tensors, which reduces paged KV cache footprint relative to the standard MHA backend. Enabling the backend requires a model config that declares MLA-specific projection dimensions; models without those fields fall back to the generic attention backend.

Processing-in-Memory market forecast dem.snippet: The report estimates a compound annual growth rate in the mid-thirties for CXL-attached memory through 2030, with data center memory expansion cited as the primary driver.

Processing-in-Memory market forecast dem.title: Memory makers raise capital spending on AI-specific DRAM lines
Processing-in-Memory market forecast dem.snippet: The vendors said AI-specific DRAM products require dedicated process and packaging investment, and that demand visibility for in-memory compute parts remains limited to sampling customers.

Processing-in-Memory adoption production.title: Leo CXL Smart Memory Controllers
Processing-in-Memory adoption production.snippet: Leo CXL memory controllers are shipping in production platforms and support memory expansion and pooling for server hosts, with published bandwidth and capacity configurations.
Processing-in-Memory adoption production.content: Leo CXL memory controllers are shipping in production platforms and support memory expansion and pooling for server hosts, with published bandwidth and capacity configurations. Astera Labs presents Leo controllers as memory expansion that appears to the host as additional system memory, so that applications use it without modification. The product material describes capacity and bandwidth expansion, not near-memory compute offload.
